correctness.rationale: The fourteen vertices ±t e_i and 8 cube corners have exactly seven pair shells of multiplicities (24,12,12,12,24,3,4): squared radii a²=t²-2t+3,4,2t²,8,e²=t²+2t+3,4t²,12. On 3/2<=t<=2 symbolic comparisons give a²<4<2t²<=8<e²<min(4t²,12); only the final antipodal shells exchange at t=sqrt3, and the axis-orthogonal shell merges with cube diagonals at t=2. Fresh independently written exhaustive 14-vertex checker reconstructed all 91 pair distances, flag face vectors for thresholds 9,16,18,32,33,36,48 after doubling t=3/2 coordinates; replayed all 32 and 80 exact certificate pairs with unique remaining coface tests; verified 2-sphere closed connected vertex links and Euler 2, cross-polytope joins S3/S6, and cone. For 32 pairs the axial thickening collapses onto preceding S2, proving the only nonzero same-degree inclusion is an integral homotopy equivalence. All other bars follow from groups in different dimensions; S6 death at min(2t,2sqrt3). Includes t=2 merged shell and t=sqrt3 joint death. Finite checks corroborate, not replace symbolic continuum proof.
residual_risks: The independent reimplementation did not formally verify a proof assistant artifact; integral homotopy follows from elementary simplicial collapses and join identifications, not field homology alone.
The uniform t statement is based on exact polynomial inequalities across the interval; finitely sampled parameter checks do not prove continuity.

value.rationale: The tetrakis hexahedron and rhombic dodecahedron are canonical fourteen-vertex Catalan shapes with two meaningful radial vertex orbits; exact Euclidean Vietoris–Rips persistence throughout their full natural interpolation is a motivated finite-metric topology question. Its 11 degree-one bars, unique degree-two, degree-three and degree-six bars have fully explicit moving endpoints. The 32-pair certificate proves an actual nontrivial intermediate axial thickening preserves the S2 inclusion. The sharp t=sqrt3 switch distinguishes two combinatorially different death mechanisms even though the Betti pattern stays stable. This goes beyond the previously known fixed t=2 endpoint and supplies precise reusable birth/death structure, without claiming a general arbitrary-point-cloud theorem.
residual_risks: Graph-family-specific rather than a general Vietoris–Rips stability theorem.
The final-death mechanism switch is combinatorial; it is not a change in the ranks of positive-dimensional homology.

limitations: Scientific assessment complete, publication plan not_ready because privacy-safe replacements missing, not a scientific rejection.
